notes.title: Let my Car No.1 connect with your Car No.0🚃《Train Capacity 300% 2》is out now🔥
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/a8be035550b247a45e9bc9ae6d7286f3f230ef88.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2752220/300


Welcome to close-quarters heaven!
Society had abandoned me.
I worked all day, but all I could think about was feeling up girls on the train.
Nobody would ever understand.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/003664bc516a102b5655106567bdc68055db0373.gif[/img]


And so, I decided to throw it all away for a chance at satisfaction...
Trawl the entire train station for targets!
The 300% packed train leaves the station once again, 
this time with an all-new "hero" and plenty of new gameplay!
Catch your targets, tease them, and give chase when they run. 
And after that, well...

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/9f63868bbc5f38fabb1f1dd171218bafca00c3d7.gif[/img]


This train is PACKED!
With all those bodies crammed together, there's really nowhere to run or hide.
What fate awaits our heroines amid the writhing mass of humanity...?

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/6bf543cf30873f9becb91a36cde478b775ea0899.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/57263e1775677fb2a6873016380dc5bdb0383840.png[/img]
Situation simulation game with a tram pervert
Avoid the sight of other passengers and touch the heroines inside the train.
Full voice of the heroines
Partial animated story presentation
Pervert skill enhancement system
Erotic event recall function
Multiple endings available
